result.topic_en: Calculation of two time intervals t, t' for smoothly transferring a damped oscillating system (period T, half logarithmic decrement λ) to another equilibrium state, using a triangle construction and logarithmic computation.
result.transcription:
Ruhige Hinüberführung zu einem andern Gleichgewichts-
Zustand.
Zwei Zeitintervalle $t$, $t'$
Schwingungsdauer $T$
Halbes Logarithmisches Decrement $\lambda$
$R$ ... Quadrant

Es sei
$P = \frac{2Rt}{T}$ $\quad Q = \frac{2Rt}{T}$
$\log p = -\lambda P$, $\log q = +\lambda Q$
Gleichungen
$p\cos P + q\cos Q = 1$
$p\sin P = q\sin Q$
Daraus
$\frac{1+pp-qq}{2p} = \cos P$ $\quad \frac{1+qq-pp}{2q} = \cos Q$
Für $2\lambda = 0.08100$ $\lambda = 0.04050$

$\cos(P+Q) = \frac{pp+qq-1}{2pq}$
